appearance_facts.fact: The other five bars are all much taller, ranging from roughly 17,500 kWh (Jun) up to 40,000 kWh (Jan), so May stands out as an extreme low value.
Month labels appear in the order Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar, May; May is the rightmost category.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Monthly Energy Usage (kWh)'; y-axis label is 'Energy Usage (kWh)'.
May's bar top sits slightly below the 10,000 kWh tick (approximately 8,000 kWh), the lowest value among all months.
Jan ≈ 40,000 kWh; Apr ≈ 29,500 kWh; Mar ≈ 27,000 kWh; Feb ≈ 20,000 kWh; Jun ≈ 17,500 kWh. May is far below even the next-lowest month (Jun).
